sanitized_projection.short_summary_en: The Human Resources Development Fund publishes Tamheer as a graduate on-the-job training product with official application steps. Eligibility is limited to Saudi nationals meeting the stated diploma or bachelor’s requirements.
sanitized_projection.evidence_note: Official HRDF English and Arabic Tamheer pages describe current application steps through HRDF electronic services and Nafath, with no closed banner. English page last-update stamp observed as 2 February 2026. Recorded as one program-level internship, not as invented employer placements. Application itself requires login via Nafath; this research did not enter private applicant areas.
